evidence: Every value the judges create to prove a mutation is either forced to be unique per review or is tied to a job/conversation the judge itself creates, so the seed and the reference's initial state cannot already hold it. (1) Job titles, candidate names and emails: functional prompt.md:11 and :15 require 'a unique title (add a short suffix for this review)', 'unique name and email' and 'suffix every title and name for this review'; gates/constraints judge.toml hro_gate_shared requires unique title, name and email and 'exactly one card'; polish prompt.md 'Use your own new job and cards (suffix titles for this review)'. Seed job titles are only Platform Engineer, Data Analyst, Product Designer; seed candidate names are 16 fixed people, none of which a suffixed probe can collide with. (2) Card letters A-F, V-Z, A2 are judge-created cards on judge-created J1/J2, so moves, orders, rejection reasons (hro_reject_reason), notes (hro_notes: 'Open a J1 card'), undo results and Activity lines (hro_activity limited to J1 and J2) are located on records absent from seed; the seed's only rejection reason (APP-301 Lena) and three notes (APP-101, APP-107, APP-301) sit on seeded applications the protocols do not grade as mutations. (3) Conversations: the graded new conversation is Tomas's J2 conversation created in T; seed has Tomas only on JOB-DATA (APP-201), and J2 is a fresh suffixed job, so hro_candidate_linked ('the card added with Tomas's account email becomes Tomas's application') cannot be pre-satisfied by APP-201; the protocol's guard 'if that address is already on J2, open a new job J3' further prevents reuse. hro_seen/hro_unread_counts/hro_msg_compose/hro_drafts act on that new conversation; Mei Lin and Rafael have no seed read markers for it. (4) The only literal probe text in any prompt is polish hro_pol_live_board's example draft 'Call back on Fri'; grep finds 0 hits in environment/assets/seed_data.json and none in solution/app/public, src/*.js or server.js. Polish failed_send/session_resume require a 'distinctive' reply. Reference drafts are browser-local (solution/app/public/js/threads.js:112,124,182 keep.set('draft.'+id)), so no reference initial state holds a draft; polish prompt also says to record and clear any pre-existing box text. (5) Seed-derived values that the judge reads rather than creates (Lena's 1 unread from reads APP-301 read_count 2 of 3 messages; seeded Platform Engineer order Greta, Ade, Marco / Priya, Samuel; Noor's note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.'; Noor's 120-message thread) are deliberate seed reads, verified to match seed_data.json, and are each conjoined with live mutations (count rises, restart persistence, paging), so they are not mutation probes pre-satisfied by seed. Weak-app trial: an app that ships the seed and fakes saves cannot show a suffixed job/card, an A2 card in J2 Screen, or a J2 conversation for Tomas, because none exist in seed; a conforming alternative is not penalised by any probe because no probe depends on the reference's ids, routes or default text. Note: tomas.varga@candidates.example appears both in prompts and seed by design (it is the candidate account whose linking is graded); a literal-grep implementation of check-probe-not-in-seed.py could flag it, which would be a mechanical false positive, not a pre-satisfied probe. This is static source evidence only; no configured judge run was performed or claimed.
